question: For which of the following calipers, a screw and nut are provided for opening and closing the caliper legs?
solution:
The correct answer is __Spring joint calipers__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Spring joint calipers__ are equipped with a screw and nut mechanism for the precise opening and closing of the caliper legs.
 
• This mechanism allows for accurate adjustments, making them ideal for fine measurements.
 
• Spring joint calipers are commonly used in metalworking and machining tasks.
 
• The screw and nut provide stability and eliminate the risk of accidental movement during use.
 
• These calipers are preferred for tasks requiring high precision.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Leg and Point Calipers:**
 
 
• These calipers do not have a screw and nut mechanism; they rely on manual adjustments.
 
• They are used for rough measurements and marking purposes.
 
 
 
• **Simple Calipers:**
 
 
• Simple calipers are basic measuring tools without any screw and nut mechanism.
 
• They are used for quick and approximate measurements.
 
 
 
• **Firm Joint Calipers:**
 
 
• Firm joint calipers use a friction joint to maintain the position of the legs.
 
• They do not have a screw and nut mechanism for adjustments.
